# Mingzy Comprehensive Knowledge Graph & System Index (LLMS-Full)

> Mingzy is a free random video chat platform that lets people connect with strangers through instant browser-based video conversations without requiring mandatory account creation.

## 1. Platform Identity & Architecture

- **Domain**: https://www.mingzy.space
- **Architecture**: Single Page Application (React 19 + Vite) with Server-Side Static Pre-Rendering (SSG) for complete indexability by search engines and AI systems.
- **Real-Time Layer**: Node.js + Socket.IO for ephemeral queue signaling and volatile session handshake.
- **Media Streaming**: Peer-to-Peer WebRTC via STUN (Google & Mozilla public servers) and DTLS-SRTP end-to-end encryption.
- **Data Retention**: Ephemeral in-memory matchmaking; no chat transcripts, video frames, or audio streams are retained or recorded.
- **Authentication**: Optional Firebase Auth (Google & Email/Password) for persistent username and theme preferences; 100% anonymous guest access is enabled by default.

## 2. Platform Comparison Matrix

| Capability | Mingzy | Legacy Omegle / Clones | Monkey.app | Emerald Chat |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Account Requirement** | None (Zero Signup) | None (Discontinued) | Mandatory Social Login | Optional / Freemium |
| **Signaling Latency** | Low-Latency WebSocket Relay | High latency / Stalled | Fast | Variable |
| **Language Filtering** | 8+ Native Language Queues | Keyword matching only | Limited | Basic |
| **P2P Encryption** | DTLS-SRTP Direct | Direct P2P (Exposed IP) | Relayed | Relayed / Ads |
| **Advertisements** | Zero intrusive ads | Ads on clones | Premium Upsells | Coinzilla / Popups |
| **Mobile Experience** | Responsive Web + Android App | Poor web only | App Centric | Web Only |

- `https://www.mingzy.space/talk-to-strangers`: Spontaneous conversations with global strangers.
- `https://www.mingzy.space/anonymous-video-chat`: Encrypted, anonymous video calling without registration.
